name: Succubus Simulator
source:
Succubus  Simulator is an episodic visual novel. It is NSFW, very queer, and sex positive. Go in expecting a complete fuckery of gender norms, a bit of plot, an emphasis on consent, and lots of coding bugs. It explores kinks like femdom, pet play, S&M, and more.

[From [url=https://welcome2heaven.itch.io/succubus-simulator]Itch.io[/url]]
